title: Sefer Chayei HaNefesh, letters-manuscript text (Hebrew)
author: Abraham Abulafia
description: Sefer Chayei HaNefesh (The Book of the Life of the Soul) by Abraham Abulafia, here in a separate Hebrew text derived from manuscript letters (a shorter text than the print edition held elsewhere in the library). Abulafia, the thirteenth-century founder of prophetic Kabbalah, wrote this work as an esoteric commentary on Maimonides' Guide of the Perplexed, interpreting its philosophical teachings on prophecy, the intellect and the soul through the mysteries of the divine names and letter combinations, which he taught as a path to prophetic union with the Active Intellect. This version is useful for comparison with the printed text. The scan was produced by optical character recognition of Hebrew and may contain errors.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/chayeihanefesh).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
